criteria.reason: Clear stepwise plan: talk, medical assessment, risk reduction, limits, report only if concrete danger.
Names independence versus safety and explains weighing through least-invasive checks and joint decision.
Does not mention mandatory Swiss check from 75 every two years; suggests annual visits and no cantonal differences.
Treats risk seriously, offers escalation, avoids paternalism by preserving autonomy and dignity.

position: medical check and risk reduction before restrictions or reporting
factual_errors: Suggests annual medical visits instead of the Swiss check every two years from age 75.
summary: Strong practical recommendation but misses the mandatory Swiss 75+ medical check and cantonal differences.
